revision: Local-coordinate model with Purdue OEP first-floor schematic

sources.identity: BALY; Ralph and Bettye Bailey Hall; 359 Northwestern Avenue
sources.response_crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84); output requested in WGS84 from the feature service
sources.layer_metadata: source_gis_layer_metadata.xml; native CRS is NAD83 StatePlane Indiana West, US survey feet
sources.notes: The feature service has no positional uncertainty statement. GIS NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 are attributes, not measured facade rows or elevations. Shape__Area/Shape__Length reflect service projection values and were not used as ground dimensions.

sources.provider: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
sources.source_date: Page revision 2026-04-03; image capture dates not supplied
sources.plan_crs: Not georeferenced; no north arrow or scale bar shown
sources.use: Exterior image supports brick, light stone bands/trim, flat parapet, two visible above-grade window rows and entry context. Official first-floor plan supports the room names and relative room groupings represented in the schematic. Neither provides calibrated exterior dimensions or a geographic plan orientation.

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
sources.publication_date: 2016-12-01; image capture date and photographer not stated
sources.use: Corroborates the raised lobby/entry tower, glazing, vertical panel, brick and pale trim. Oblique view cannot establish dimensions or true-north orientation.

coordinate_transform.axes: X east, Y north, Z up
coordinate_transform.method_limit: Project-compatible local approximation; not a surveyed CRS transform.

placement.origin_method: Planar centroid of the raw FID 411 polygon after the documented project-local conversion
placement.asset_geometry: Local XY around the proposed origin; root object transform remains identity
placement.integration_note: The shared manifest and master placement marker were not changed. The master coordinator must set this collection instance origin before the local-coordinate asset can replace the existing campus-coordinate massing library.
placement.independent_area_cross_check: EPSG:26916 (NAD83 / UTM zone 16N) projection of raw WGS84 ring: 841.956 m2, perimeter 129.508 m. The roughly 0.02% area difference from the project approximation is projection-method variance.
placement.structural_shell_comparison: Outer structural wall base and upper wall ring are generated from all 22 distinct transformed FID 411 vertices. Therefore the modeled structural footprint coincides with the source ring by construction; GIS is a campus map outline, not a certified survey. Entry tower/canopy and facade trim intentionally project beyond that wall footprint.
placement.orientation: Structural shell follows source polygon vertices. Entrance location/orientation is selected from the long west-facing wall per photo interpretation, but oblique imagery does not independently prove the true-north-facing facade.

height_and_levels.status: Estimated, not measured. The 7.5 m wall height is photo-scaled. Tower height tentatively uses GIS R=33.4 interpreted as feet; the field definition/units are not documented and this is not treated as verified height evidence.
height_and_levels.source_conflict: GIS NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 conflict with two visible above-grade facade rows in Purdue's current exterior image. Actual level accounting and any lower-level contribution are unresolved.

interior.modeled_detail: 2,610 flat first-floor room-zone/circulation faces are included in the stable building mesh and clipped to the official GIS shell polygon. No unsourced furniture or upper-floor room layout was invented.
interior.assumptions: Plan regions were traced from Purdue OEP's published image and proportionally mapped to the GIS footprint envelope. The plan has no scale bar or north arrow; room dimensions, exact wall locations, and orientation are schematic/unverified.

geometry_edits: Replaced campus-world one-box extrusion with a detailed local-coordinate closed shell using the official GIS ring.

Added photo-supported red-brick pattern, two rows of repeated windows, limestone surrounds/bands and plinth, flat parapet coping, raised entry tower, tall glazing, vertical panel, entrance surround and canopy.
Added a source-backed colored first-floor room-zone schematic and neutral circulation plate; no unsourced furnishings or upper floors were added.
remaining_uncertainty: Campus GIS geometry is not a certified wall survey and has no published positional tolerance.
Parapet/tower heights and tower projection are estimated; GIS elevation-like field meanings/units are not defined.
Facade orientation, entry exact location and unseen facades remain approximate from oblique photos.
First-floor plan alignment, dimensions and north orientation are schematic; no sections or height measurements were found.

grading: The repository's earlier 8/10 grade predates this local-coordinate/interior revision; this revision is intentionally stopped for a new independent grade.
